review.reviewer: OpenAI Codex author source/dependency/licence assessment; independent PR review pending
review.rationale: AF-CTR-06 author source and licence assessment at fdb963a43ab5aad2808a74d2cbb7f947a082dbae; independent PR review and fetched-head native full gates remain pending. The current center adds bound PostgreSQL cluster lineage, protected source backup metadata, complete versioned archive inventory and isolated same-invocation recovery with atomic floor and quarantine admission. Its schema-10 route accepts supported delivered 601.1 or 615.1 source provenance and uses the verified 615.1 bridge, while 0011 recovery retains the target floor and guards interruption, credential selection and pending work. Linux real PG18, cryptographic, archive, child interruption and isolated synthetic runtime checks were exercised; provider/issuer transport and external recorder are controlled substitutes and do not establish hosted promotion or delivery. Windows native file, ACL and child tests ran on a checked composite worktree; its full PostgreSQL client/restore route and physical power-loss directory durability remain unproven. The Docker context admits only the two exact embedded inventories; profile r113 binds the changed image and all newly carried inputs, with unchanged Worker and platform bridge assets. The Linux bridge is from the released 615.1 OCI carrier and the Windows bridge is a separately built reviewed 8e5 source, both preserving Contracts 437.1 legal closure; current runtime uses published Contracts 450.1. Existing Go x/sys was already admitted and changes from indirect to direct without a version or module closure change. r59 extends r58 and r8 extends r7; historical records remain immutable. This is author assessment, not independent approval, full acceptance or a release. The following exact scan-control source commit 5715653848fb4cb95c513d4f0602e2218dfd7b6f adds only the two already reviewed public legal-record digests in the exact r8 and r9 receipt paths to the existing per-file generic-api-key false-positive pins; its tests retain positive and negative controls. The complete commit range remains scanned with the same pinned gitleaks rules and redaction. Source commits 8a8a8de2490ccd42981d1222d13d45fb1c3fdb44 and 91606c2a314ce12e522275d51fa3f7519d136895 fix the actual Windows go vet unsafe-pointer diagnostic in the mapped-source test by using the existing pinned x/sys process-memory APIs for a real writable mapping and by checking the source file handle closed successfully before the test write. The test verifies a complete write/readback, exact source mutation and unchanged private copy. Native Windows vet and the targeted test passed on the fetched 6a78 base with the byte-matched final test overlay; those checks are not a later fetched-head full profile or independent review. This test-only input and the exact r10 public legal-digest scan pin with positive/negative controls do not alter Worker, image or bridge asset inputs, so existing runtime r59 and release r113 are retained; no dependency version or published record changes. This is author assessment only; Windows PostgreSQL recovery, hosted promotion and overall acceptance remain unproven. At source commit 5c5b5b64d8982a770e640ce36b429276446f24cf the synthetic Linux restore drill creates a unique owner-private system temporary directory for its checked backup and metadata, records their paths and hashes, and leaves them available for investigation. The real product output guard still checks every ancestor and object and refuses unsafe paths; neither host permissions nor production backup logic changes. The preceding formal 80bb failure was faithfully reproduced with the exact Go binary on the verification cache path, and a separate real Go guard diagnostic established the non-sticky group-writable ancestor refusal. An affected real two-PostgreSQL drill on the changed source completed all eleven stages; the external recorder is mocked and no hosted delivery or native Node file operation is asserted. Profile r114 and both r60 provenance records are append-only successors because eng/center.py is a declared image input; unchanged Worker and bridge asset inputs remain exact. This is author evidence, not independent review or fetched-head full verification.

review.maintenance: Every input bound by this receipt is named in its inputs map. A later change to any of them needs a new immutable successor receipt that chains from the active one, and the policy input and its review are re-bound together. Committed receipts are never edited or reused.
review.immutableHistory: Admitted review records are retained in Git history. A dependency change requires a new reviewed source commit and updated input-bound rationale; never amend an already accepted provenance record.

dependencyClasses.build-inputs: Complete exact npm lock inventory; licence metadata is preserved, not inferred as a redistribution grant. Existing transitive development prereleases are named build-only migration inputs and cannot enter runtime/stable closures.
dependencyClasses.runtime: Only the independently enforced existing shipped artifact records admit runtime inputs and legal scopes.
dependencyClasses.native: No new product native capability; existing tooling and Cloud base image/native runtime obligations remain with the exact artifact profiles.

publication.promotion: sealed candidate; existing provider identity verification; no registry tooling publication or credential in PR
